findings.message: Unsupported: ObjectFilter cannot say 'with mana cost {0} or {1}'. That is the printed mana cost, not the mana value: a card with no mana cost (an artifact land such as Darksteel Citadel) and an artifact with a coloured one-mana cost both have to be excluded, so a manaValue Le 1 comparison, with or without colorless, is a different set of cards. Needs a printed-mana-cost predicate.
